---
title: "pca"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
triggerR <- new.env()
source("R/read_data.R", local = triggerR)
if (!exists("trigger_5min")) trigger_5min <- triggerR$read_trigger_5min()
trigger_5min <- triggerR$drop_suspect(trigger_5min)
```

```{r}
phis <- trigger_5min %>%
  filter(
    origin %in% c("smartwatchhigh", "smartwatchlow"),
    !variable %in% c("step", "cal")
  ) %>%
  select(userId, bucket_5min, variable, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = mean)

x <- phis %>%
  select(-userId, -bucket_5min) %>%
  drop_na()

tibble(total = nrow(phis), complete = nrow(x))

pca <- prcomp(x, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE, retx = FALSE)
summary(pca)
```

```{r}
round(pca$rotation, 3)
```

```{r}
sort(abs(pca$rotation[, "PC7"]), decreasing = TRUE)
```


```{r}
p_pca <- factoextra::fviz_pca_var(
  pca,
  axes = c(1, 2),
  col.var = "contrib",
  gradient.cols = c("#440154", "#21908C", "#FDE725"),
  repel = TRUE
) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

p_pca
```

```{r}
scores <- predict(pca, newdata = x)[, 1:2] %>%
  as_tibble()
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
p_temp <- scores %>%
  mutate(bodytemp = x$bodytemp) %>%
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, colour = bodytemp)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .1, size = .2) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal()

p_temp
```
